Two ways to run it

Hands-on or hands-off.

Same agents, two operating modes. Switch between them per agent or per day.

Manual

You drive.

Pick an agent, give it a direction, hit run. Drafts back in 30 seconds.

  • Know what you want to post about today
  • Steer the agent with a quick prompt
  • Iterate until the draft feels right
  • Great for time-sensitive takes
Autopilot

It runs while you sleep.

Set a schedule once. The agents run in the background and send finished drafts to your inbox, Slack, or wherever you work.

  • 3-5 fresh drafts in your inbox every morning
  • Routes to Email, Slack, Discord, or ClickUp
  • You just review, pick, and post
  • Solves the consistency problem - forever

LigoSocial goes where you go

Our extension lives in your browser - ready to help the moment inspiration strikes or engagement calls

The Problem

Staring at the comment box thinking "what do I even say?"

You know engaging with your ICP's posts is important. But writing thoughtful comments for each one? That's 20+ minutes per session you don't have.

The Solution

Generate context-aware comments that actually sound like you - in one click. 93% of users say nobody can tell it's AI-assisted.

Try it free
The Problem

Your post went viral. Now you have 47 comments to reply to.

Great engagement is a blessing and a curse. You want to reply to everyone - but you also have actual work to do. Those comments sit unanswered for days.

The Solution

Bulk Reply generates personalized responses to every comment - all in your voice. Review, tweak if needed, and post. 47 replies in 5 minutes.

The Problem

"This would make a great post!" - and then you forget it.

You're scrolling LinkedIn, see an amazing post format, a hot take you want to respond to, a YouTube video that sparked an idea... but you're in the middle of something. By tomorrow, it's gone.

The Solution

Right-click → Save to Inspirations. The extension captures it instantly. Come back when you're ready to write - your ideas are waiting.

"I have so much content... but no LinkedIn posts"

Your newsletter, podcast, or blog is full of insights. But rewriting everything for LinkedIn? That's another job.

Paste any URL - get LinkedIn-ready posts in your voice, instantly.

"What should I post? When? About what?"

Your analytics dashboard has answers - but who has time to analyze charts? You need insights, not homework.

Just ask in plain English - "When do my posts perform best?" Get instant answers.

"I keep finding great prospects... and losing them"

You scroll through LinkedIn, spot perfect-fit leads, but by the time you're ready to reach out - you've forgotten who they were.

One-click save - build your prospect list while you browse. Never lose a lead again.

"I want to engage consistently - but with WHO?"

Random engagement is exhausting. You need a system - specific people, specific topics, founders you follow, marketers in your niche.

Build engagement lists - by people or by post criteria. Your curated feed, ready when you are.

Why let great content die?

That post that crushed it 6 months ago? Your new followers never saw it. We resurface your top performers from 2+ quarters back and help you rewrite them - fresh versions that won't trigger LinkedIn's duplicate detection.
